title: Scalar-compatible nodal scheme families
statement: Let $f:C\to B$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. It is a scalar-compatible nodal relative curve if it is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ [def-weil-field, def-weil-algebraic-closure] and geometric point $g:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to B$, the geometric fibre $D=C\times_B\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-weil-geometric-fibre] is pure of dimension one [def-weil-pure-dimension]. At every point $x\in D$ with no smooth open neighbourhood over $\Omega$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], $x$ is closed [def-weil-closed-points] and its maximal-ideal completed local $\Omega$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], with scalars given by [def-trf-completed-local-scalar-map], is isomorphic to $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Empty fibres are allowed, and no properness, connectedness, separatedness or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed. The closed-point completed-algebra condition is also defined independently for any scheme over $\Omega$ and any of its points.
